fact: The Statistics Act, Cap. 351 (R.E. 2023), in force since 2 November 2015 and amended in 2018 and 2019, continues the National Bureau of Statistics as autonomous public office and establishes the NBS Board and the National Statistical System.
title: The Statistics Act, Chapter 351 R.E. 2023
publisher: Government Printer, Dodoma (Office of the Attorney General)
